neighbours.label: the space or digit that opens the final number in a percentage breakdown across several destinations or categories ('..., and 12 percent to Asia'), as against the same breakdown written with words instead of numbers
fire: Its wine goes 50 percent to Britain, 30 percent to Germany, and 20 percent to Japan.
Of the budget, 45 percent goes to schools, 35 percent to roads, and 20 percent to parks.
Coffee exports go 55 percent to the U.S., 25 percent to Europe, and 20 percent to Asia.
Voters split 48 percent for Smith, 41 percent for Jones, and 11 percent for others.
Sales came 62 percent from Texas, 24 percent from Ohio, and 14 percent from Maine.
Students were 52 percent female, 46 percent male, and 2 percent other.
Funding comes 70 percent from fees, 20 percent from grants, and 10 percent from gifts.
Steel shipments go 40 percent to China, 33 percent to India, and 27 percent to Brazil.
quiet: Its wine goes mostly to Britain, partly to Germany, and a little to Japan.
Of the budget, most goes to schools, a lot to roads, and the rest to parks.
Coffee exports go mainly to the U.S., then to Europe, and finally to Asia.
Voters split mostly for Smith, many for Jones, and a few for others.
Sales came mostly from Texas, some from Ohio, and hardly any from Maine.
Students were mostly female, many male, and a few other.
Funding comes mostly from fees, partly from grants, and a bit from gifts.
Steel shipments go largely to China, then to India, and finally to Brazil.
